items.rationale: The failed indoor heating pipe is covered under §2.4.3. Section 7.1.9 limits the upgrade to the plain copper equivalent: 6.4 m × €15.
Section 7.1.9 excludes the chrome premium but allows the equivalent standard copper fittings: 4 × €10.
Section 7.1.9 limits payment to standard copper fittings for the repaired section: 5 × €20.
Section 7.1.9 limits payment to one equivalent standard copper elbow at €20.
Minor fasteners used in the repair are covered under §7.1.7(c): 8 × €1.10.
The 10 mm clamps do not match the documented pipe dimensions, so §7.1.8(e) likely excludes them. If their use in the covered repair is documented, the estimate is 4 × €5.50.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers the repair fixings; the matching clamp prior is approximately €25 gross for all four.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary repair labour, while §7.1.9 excludes any separately identifiable upgrade labour. At the full repair rate, 6.75 hours × €88 is approximately €595.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers helper labour for the repair, with no separately quantified upgrade hours: 5.75 hours × approximately €73.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 cover re-insulation at the former rock-wool specification: 6 × €20, without the Armaflex premium.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers binding wire as an installation consumable: 2 kg × €9.80.
Section 7.1.9 excludes the sensor because it was not present before the loss. The conditional figure is €150 for one installed app-connected sensor.
Section 7.1.9 excludes the valve because it is a new addition, not a replacement. The conditional figure is €220 for one installed valve.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e) allow lump-sum minor repair consumables: one charge at the €36 gross prior.
Section 7.1.7(f) covers the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. This is the only one listed, at the €79 gross prior.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of removed repair debris. The matching case supports €60 for the single charge.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes administrative and processing fees billed in addition to labour and materials. The conditional estimate for one fee is €25.
